title: Balance
suits: cost vs value, price drops, 'same result for less': pricing slides, unit economics, a cheaper way to the same outcome

params.--field: the slide field (mustard); the scale is drawn in the field's ink: dark wood on light fields, pale ash on dark ones
params..st-balance-wt / .st-balance-coint: the two prices (old cost on the iron weight, new cost on the coin)
params.T0 / T1: the beam's start and rest tilt in degrees (script)

details: the iron weight slides off the cost pan, tips over the edge, drops and lands on the floor with a squash
it stays on the floor beside the scale, where it fell, with its own shadow
a dust puff spreads where it lands, and the stand jolts 3 px with the thud
the cost pan kicks sideways as the weight leaves it
the beam swings on a damped spring: overshoots the value side and settles at 10°
the pans are pendulums: they swing on their strings, out of step with the beam, and come to rest
the coin falls spinning (it flips edge-on and back) and bounces twice: 36 px, then 10 px
a white clink ring spreads from the coin when it lands
the beam dips a hair when the coin lands
each pan's floor shadow grows and darkens as the pan comes down, shrinks as it rises
the needle on the dial swings with the beam across 13 ticks
the gem's velvet cushion gives a little as the value pan drops
a glint sweeps across the gem once the scale has settled
a soft spotlight from above and a lit edge on the floor
